messages:
maria: Heads-up — I’m seeing a perf regression on the AMD serving pool after the autotuner change last night. p99 for chat generation (+max tokens) up ~18% and token throughput dipped.

raj: Which models / seqlen distributions? any recent kernel fallback logs?

maria: Quick profiling snapshot:
```
model: redwood/alpaca-7b
pool: amd-mi250-prod
time: 2024-06-05T03:14:22Z
seq_len: avg=64 p50=12 p90=82 p99=240
kv_hit_rate: 0.62
chosen_kernel: conv_gemm_ln_fp16_longseq_v2
fallbacks: none
p99_latency_ms: baseline=210 -> now=247 (+17.6%)
```

chen: hmm. autotuner picked longseq kernel even though p50 is 12. Why longseq? maybe heuristic used avg_seq_len which got skewed by a small number of long-rollouts.

taylor: Could KV caching be inflating avg_seq_len? if cached prefixes get counted as longer sequences we might misclassify.

maria: Exactly. saw high kv_hit_rate on chat sessions where user prompt + context made keys appear long in the profiler. The runtime's seqlen estimate uses total tokens seen in session which includes cached prefixes.

raj: That explains increased p99 — longseq kernel has higher kernel-launch overhead for short-continuation bursts. We need sequence-length-aware routing that discounts KV-prefixed tokens.

maria: Proposed temporary routing override (canary) for amd pool:
```
routing_rule:
  when: pool == "amd-mi250" && (kv_hit_rate > 0.5) && (seq_len_p50 < 32)
  prefer_kernel: conv_gemm_ln_fp16_shortseq_v1
  reason: avoid longseq kernel on cached short-continuations
```

chen: +1. Also add metric kernel_miss_rate and per-kernel latency breakdown to the console so we can watch regressions.

taylor: Suggest we roll the override to 10% traffic for 1h, monitor p50/p95/p99, cost_per_100k_tokens, kernel_switch_rate.

buildbot: deploy started: routing-configs/service=autotune-bridge canary=0.1 user=maria

maria: I'll open a quick eval with a synthetic chat workload that simulates high-KV hit short-turns and post results.

raj: Nice. If the canary looks good we should make autotuner exclude cached-prefix tokens from avg_seq_len calculation in the medium term.

maria: Filed follow-up ticket: INT-1543 (autotuner: seqlen calc should ignore kv-prefixed tokens). Adding screenshots once canary finishes. :eyes:

taylor: Thanks — keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
